title.ko: FIGUR: An AI-Driven Collaborative Robotic System for Expressive Portrait Generation
title.en: FIGUR: An AI-Driven Collaborative Robotic System for Expressive Portrait Generation

subtitle.en: Hojeong Kim and Jinho Son / ICAIIC 2026

description.ko: 2026 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information and Communication(ICAIIC)에서 발표한 논문으로, 표현력 있는 초상화를 그리는 AI 기반 협업 로봇 시스템 FIGUR를 다룹니다.
description.en: Presented at the 2026 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Information and Communication (ICAIIC), this paper introduces FIGUR, an AI-driven collaborative robotic system for expressive portrait generation.
